title: A HIT CRAWLER JUMPS BACK FARTHER
why: His Q5: enemy feel. A hit body is drawn pushed 5 px for 0.16 s whatever it is. The Crawler is the smallest, lightest common machine (radius 15) so 5 px barely showed. It now jumps back 8 px at the full flash, easing to 0 over the same 0.16 s. Raiders and the rest keep 5 px.
now: A Crawler you hit now jumps back farther.
